subject.title: fix(memory): exclude extraPaths from shared scope hash to avoid unnecessary reindexing

question: Should built-in memory indexes move to a same-workspace shared SQLite store by default, and what migration, session visibility, and plugin SDK contract must ship with that change?
rationale: The PR changes shipped persistent storage identity and cross-agent memory visibility, so automation cannot choose the product/security boundary safely.

options.title: Approve contract first
options.body: Define the shared-store identity, migration/rebuild behavior, session filtering model, and SDK surface before this branch can land.

options.title: Narrow to hash-only repair
options.body: Keep existing per-agent storage and accept only the extraPaths/index-identity correction if maintainers decide default sharing is not ready.

options.title: Pause this branch
options.body: Keep the canonical design issue open and close or hold this PR until a first-class shared-memory design is sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve contract first
recommendation.body: Define the shared-store identity, migration/rebuild behavior, session filtering model, and SDK surface before this branch can land.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest current-main history across the memory resolver, manager, and memory-host SDK paths that define this storage boundary.
